content.text: Summary: Read T-4002, checked both namespaces, and pulled the pipeline pod's logs. The `kubectl set image` succeeded but the new ReplicaSet's pods were rejected by PodSecurity "restricted" admission in the `documents` namespace (missing `allowPrivilegeEscalation=false`, `runAsNonRoot=true`, `capabilities.drop=[ALL]`, and `seccompProfile`). Old 1.4.2 pods keep running since no new pod can be admitted. Resolved the ticket with the cause, event evidence, and a securityContext snippet the owner can add to the Deployment manifest.
